name: Norwegian Cruise Line
outlook:
What Norwegian Cruise Line says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDA and marginQ4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be $414 million and Adjusted Operational EBITDA margin for the quarter is expected to be 25.0%.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted net cruise costQ4 2026 Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding fuel per Capacity Day is expected to be up 1.7% on a Constant Currency basis versus 2025.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDA2026 full year Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be approximately $2.55 billion.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted net income and EPSFull year Adjusted Net Income is expected to be approximately $789 million. Adjusted EPS is expected to be approximately $1.70.
  • Full year 2026: net yield2026 full year Net Yield on a Constant Currency basis is expected to be down approximately 4.4% versus 2025.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
